name: Ilsheta
desc: Ilsheta in her hooded linen mantle and lamp-chimney visor, the dawnglass lamp at her chest.

name: Stillwater Lamp
desc: A sea-glass lamp and a wet-stone mantle, with reed plates ringing the visor, from the shallows of the Fallen Shaft.

name: First Bell Lamp
desc: The honour of the year's first bell: a pale dial-stone mantle carved with ten hour-marks over a dark hem, and a small glass bell inside the lamp.
